]

# Cart context
cart_subtotal = 68
cart_total = 74
cart_shipping = 6

# Filter active promotions
active_promos = [p for p in promotions if p["active"] == 1]

print("=== LOYALTY POINTS BALANCE ===")

print(f"Points: 7,181")
print(f"Store Credit: $46.00")

print(f"\n=== ACTIVE PROMOTIONS ({len(active_promos)}) ===")
for p in active_promos:
    cats = json.loads(p["category_restriction_json"])
    cat_str = "All categories" if not cats else ", ".join(cats)
    min_str = f"Min ${p['min_purchase']}" if p['min_purchase'] > 0 else "No minimum"

# Validate PROMO0F1B01 against the cart
print("\n=== PROMO0F1B01 VALIDATION ===")
promo = promotions[0]  # PROMO0F1B01
checks = []

# Check 1: Is it active?
is_active = promo["active"] == 1
checks.append(("Active", is_active, "Yes" if is_active else "No - promo is inactive"))

# Check 2: Has it expired? (current date context: 2026-09-14)
from datetime import datetime
current_date = datetime(2026, 9, 14)
expiry = datetime.strptime(promo["expiry_date"], "%Y-%m-%d")
not_expired = current_date <= expiry
checks.append(("Not expired", not_expired, f"Expires {promo['expiry_date']} - {'valid' if not_expired else 'EXPIRED'}"))

# Check 3: Minimum purchase met?
min_met = cart_subtotal >= promo["min_purchase"]
checks.append(("Min purchase met", min_met, f"Cart ${cart_subtotal} >= min ${promo['min_purchase']}" if min_met else f"Cart ${cart_subtotal} < min ${promo['min_purchase']}"))

cats = json.loads(promo["category_restriction_json"])
no_cat_restriction = len(cats) == 0
checks.append(("Category OK", no_cat_restriction, "No category restriction" if no_cat_restriction else f"Restricted to: {cats}"))

# All checks pass?
all_pass = all(c[1] for c in checks)

for label, passed, detail in checks:

    print(f"  {status} {label}: {detail}")

if all_pass:

    if promo["discount_type"] == "percentage":
        raw_discount = cart_subtotal * promo["discount_value"] / 100
        actual_discount = min(raw_discount, promo["max_discount"])
        new_subtotal = cart_subtotal - actual_discount
        new_total = new_subtotal + cart_shipping
        print(f"\n  ✅ PROMO0F1B01 IS VALID for your cart!")
        print(f"  Discount: {promo['discount_value']}% of ${cart_subtotal} = ${raw_discount:.2f}")
        print(f"  Max discount cap: ${promo['max_discount']}")
        print(f"  Actual discount applied: ${actual_discount:.2f}")
        print(f"  New subtotal: ${new_subtotal:.2f}")
        print(f"  Shipping: ${cart_shipping:.2f}")
        print(f"  New total: ${new_total:.2f}")
        print(f"  You save: ${actual_discount:.2f}")
else:
    print(f"\n  ❌ PROMO0F1B01 CANNOT be applied to your cart.")
